_comment: THE fairness-band owner.  One band definition for the /trade meter, sticky
tray, balancers, the fairness explanation, the Analyze Trade market lens /
private Asset-Only decision, Best Offers, the package builder, the
suggestions badge, and any multi-team / public adapter.  Python reads this
file (src/valuation_math/fairness_bands.py); the JS mirror
(frontend/lib/fairness-bands.js) is pinned to it by
tests/valuation_math/test_fairness_bands.py.
fairness_bands_v2 (owner decisions 2026-10-20, recorded verbatim in
docs/owner/FAIRNESS_V2_DECISIONS_2026-10-20.md; evidence in
docs/trade/FAIRNESS_BANDS_V2_2026-10-20.md).  A gap is classified against
the LARGER PACKAGE UTILITY (OD-F2): relativePct = |gap| / max(U_A, U_B),
where U is the active package model's depth-discounted package utility
(geom_q078_v1: U = sum q^i * v_i over the package's values, best first).
The gap itself is unchanged (recvAdjusted - sendAdjusted, which equals
U_R - U_G under geom), so numerator and denominator now share one scale.
v1 divided by the larger ADJUSTED side, which adds the discarded depth
back and widened the fair band as packages got deeper.  A 1-for-1 is
byte-identical to v1 (U = v = adjusted total).  The rollback package model
(ktc_2026_04) has no per-package utility, so under it the pair's adjusted
totals stand in -- exactly the v1 basis.
fair     |gap| < absoluteMinimum  OR  relativePct < slightPct
slight   relativePct < unfairPct
unfair   relativePct < lopsidedPct
lopsided otherwise
Non-finite input (NaN, Infinity, null, non-number, negative base) is
REFUSED in both languages (FairnessInputError, code
fairness_input_not_finite) -- never classified, never 'fair'.
Cut points 3.5 / 9 / 18 % are unchanged from v1 (KTC-era 350 / 900 / 1800
meter bands over a 10,000-point one-star package).  The 250-point floor is
kept EXPLICITLY as an owner-approved prior (OD-F3).  Every number is a
declared PRIOR, owner-approved for launch (OD-F5) and validated after
launch against at-the-time market trades (OD-F4, postLaunchValidation).
fairTradeLevels is OD-F1: which band level(s) count as a FAIR TRADE for a
binary fair / not-fair answer (a public adapter reads it from here, never
a literal).  q = 0.78 is not a band and is never modified here.

ownerDecisions.OD-F1: FAIR TRADE = band 'fair' only (matches the private NO - TOO CLOSE definition); overall FAIR still requires every team to be FAIR
ownerDecisions.OD-F2: Gap denominator = the larger package utility (not the larger adjusted side); 1-for-1 unchanged; one shared rule, so the private meter, Best Offers and the Package Builder move with it
ownerDecisions.OD-F3: Keep the 250-point absolute minimum explicitly, as an owner-approved prior
ownerDecisions.OD-F5: Publish fairness_bands_v2 as an owner-approved prior; validate after launch (OD-F4)

postLaunchValidation.target: at-the-time market trades: point-in-time canonical values on identity-proven market-trade groups (box-local data/intel plus the temporal ledger), chronological holdout
postLaunchValidation.until: every number in this file remains a declared prior; a validated replacement is a new version

fairness_bands_v1.note: Descriptive only, not loadable.  Same cut points and floor; the denominator was max(sendAdjusted, recvAdjusted).  Receipts stamped v1 were produced under that rule.
